chunks.text: ITC — Immunity Therapy Center in Tijuana, Mexico — provides customised alternative cancer treatment designed to stimulate the immune system and target malignant cells. Programs are tailored to each person's unique biological profile, medical history, and stage of diagnosis. Founded by Dr. Carlos Bautista. Located in Tijuana, Mexico, just minutes across the U.S. border, near San Diego International Airport (SAN, 25 minutes away). ITC offers free rides to and from the airport. The page states the centre is approved by COFEPRIS.
chunks.title: What ITC is

chunks.text: Treatment costs start at $18,995 USD for standard multi-week programs. Total costs vary based on protocol duration, specific therapies required, and diagnostic needs. The base package price listed on the profile is $18,995 USD.
chunks.title: ITC base price

chunks.text: The $18,995 USD base package includes: physician consultations and daily care; a customised alternative therapy suite; daily IV nutrition and natural supplements; medical monitoring and nursing care; local transportation assistance; and patient companion support services. Patients can request a personalised quote based on required length of stay and customised therapeutic needs.
chunks.title: ITC base package inclusions

chunks.text: Medical Director: Dr. Carlos Bautista, M.D. Treating physicians listed: Dr. David Alvarez, M.D., Dr. Adolfo Carrillo, M.D., and Dr. Pablo Orozco, M.D. The page states the medical team consists of licensed physicians and specialists.
chunks.title: ITC doctors

chunks.text: Eligibility depends on cancer type, stage, physical strength, organ function, and medical history. Patients undergo a medical evaluation prior to acceptance. Candidacy depends on factors such as cancer type, stage, organ functionality, previous conventional treatments (chemotherapy or radiation), and current physical strength. Patients submit prior diagnosis reports, imaging results, blood tests, and medical history for detailed physician evaluation.
chunks.title: Eligibility and assessment

chunks.text: How it works at ITC: 1) Initial Medical Review — patients submit prior diagnosis reports, imaging results, blood tests, and medical history. 2) Individual Treatment Planning — a care pathway is created based on diagnosis, tumor location, biological health condition, and treatment goals. 3) Treatment Explanation — physicians explain each therapy, such as laser therapy, hyperthermia, or biomagnetic therapy. 4) Medical Monitoring — daily clinical assessments and periodic blood tests. 5) Follow-Up Support — post-treatment protocols, lifestyle advice, and continued communication guidance after returning home. 6) Coordination With Existing Doctors — patients are encouraged to share updates with their home healthcare providers.
chunks.title: How treatment works

chunks.text: The profile states: cancer care outcomes vary based on individual biology, stage, and previous therapies; benefits and limitations of alternative therapies should be reviewed carefully before starting; possible side effects, detox reactions, or physical changes should be discussed with medical professionals; patients should avoid delaying necessary standard treatments without consulting their primary oncologist; and seeking a second opinion can help. This bot does not give medical advice or a diagnosis.
chunks.title: Risks and medical considerations

chunks.text: ITC is located near San Diego International Airport (SAN), and shuttle services facilitate border crossings and local transit to medical appointments and affiliated hotel accommodations. San Diego International Airport (SAN) is just 25 minutes from Tijuana. Tijuana also has its own airport, Tijuana International Airport (TIJ). The profile page states ITC offers free rides to and from the airport, and lists local transportation assistance in the base package inclusions. Attractions mentioned on the page include Avenida Revolución and the Tijuana Cultural Center.

chunks.text: Alternative Adenocarcinoma Cancer Treatment in Tijuana, Mexico, at ITC: Out-Patient Program, 3 weeks, $18,995 USD. In-Patient Program, 3 weeks, $30,000 USD. The In-Patient program is specifically designed for those requiring 24/7 medical supervision or those with mobility challenges. Adenocarcinoma originates in the glandular cells of organs such as the lungs, colon, breast, or prostate.
chunks.title: Adenocarcinoma price in Tijuana

chunks.text: Included in the Adenocarcinoma Out-Patient Program ($18,995 USD, 3 weeks): weekly comprehensive lab work (CBC, blood chemistry, immunology assessment, kidney function, metabolic and coagulation panels TP/TPT, specific tumor markers, and urinalysis); one prescribed X-ray, ultrasound, or CT scan of one area as directed by the ITC physician; all core alternative treatments listed as standard within the 3-week program; two health-focused meals daily during treatment hours; standard medications in the out-patient protocol; and one post-discharge consultation with an ITC doctor after 3 months.
chunks.title: Adenocarcinoma Out-Patient inclusions

chunks.text: Included in the Adenocarcinoma In-Patient Program ($30,000 USD, 3 weeks): 24/7 medical supervision with constant access to doctor and nursing care; full room and board with private accommodations and three nutritious meals daily (Monday through Sunday); extensive diagnostics including comprehensive weekly lab panels with tumor markers and immune function monitoring; one prescribed X-ray, ultrasound, or CT scan per doctor's orders; full access to all program-specific alternative and integrative interventions; pharmacy support with medications specific to the in-patient protocol; and a follow-up consultation with an ITC doctor after 3 months.

chunks.text: Typical 3-week itinerary at ITC Tijuana: Week 1 — Evaluation and Initiation: arrival, comprehensive diagnostic blood panels, and the first phase of immune-boosting therapies and detoxification. Week 2 — Intensive Therapy: daily rotation of specialised alternative treatments tailored to the tumor's response and the patient's energy levels. Week 3 — Consolidation and Planning: final round of therapy, concluding lab work, and development of a customised home-care program. A follow-up consultation with an ITC doctor is included after 3 months. No specific number of recovery days is stated on these pages.
